v.s: By the sky containing great stars
v.c: By the sky full of constellations,
v.h: The People of the Fire Pit

v.s: And [by] the promised Day
v.c: and the promised Day ˹of Judgment˺,

q: (all those persons and things that will present evidence)
and the day when people are presented
(on the plain of Araf a at, namely the day of Arafaat the 9th of Dhul Hijjah)!
v.s: And [by] the witness and what is witnessed,
v.c: and the witness and what is witnessed!

q: (Referring to a nation of Kuffaar who killed many Mu'mineen because they accepted Imaan at the hands of a youngster, Allaah says,)
are the people of the trenches
v.s: Destroyed [i.e., cursed] were the companions of the trench
v.c: Condemned are the makers of the ditch—

q: (who lit fires in the trenches to burn alive)...
v.s: [Containing] the fire full of fuel,
v.c: the fire ˹pit˺, filled with fuel—

v.s: When they were sitting near it.
v.c: when they sat around it,

v.s: And they, to what they were doing against the believers, were witnesses.
v.c: watching what they had ˹ordered to be˺ done to the believers,

q: except that they believed in Allaah, the Mighty, Most Worthy of praise...
v.s: And they resented them not except because they believed in God, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy,
v.c: who they resented for no reason other than belief in Allah—the Almighty, the Praiseworthy—

q: ...to Whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. Allaah is Witness to everything
(and will severely punish the Kuffaar for what they did).
v.s: To whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And God, over all things, is Witness.
v.c: ˹the One˺ to Whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and earth. And Allah is a Witness over all things.

q: Verily those who harm the Mu'mineen and Mu'minaat and do not repent thereafter, for them shall be the punishment of Jahannam and the punishment of burning.
v.s: Indeed, those who have tortured the believing men and believing women and then have not repented will have the punishment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the Burning Fire.
v.c: Those who persecute the believing men and women and then do not repent will certainly suffer the punishment of Hell and the torment of burning.

q: those who have Imaan and who carry out good deeds shall have Jannaat beneath which rivers flow. That is the supreme success
(even though they had to suffer temporarily in the world).
v.s: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great attainment.
v.c: Surely those who believe and do good will have Gardens under which rivers flow. That is the greatest triumph.

q: of your Rabb is severe indeed.
v.s: Indeed, the assault [i.e., vengeance] of your Lord is severe.
v.c: Indeed, the ˹crushing˺ grip of your Lord is severe.

q: Verily, it is He Who creates the first time and then creates again.
v.s: Indeed, it is He who originates [creation] and repeats.
v.c: ˹For˺ He is certainly the One Who originates and resurrects ˹all˺.

q: He is the Most Forgiving, All Loving...
v.s: And He is the Forgiving, the Affectionate,
v.c: And He is the All-Forgiving, All-Loving—

v.s: Honourable Owner of the Throne,
v.c: Lord of the Throne, the All-Glorious,

q: ...and the One Who does as He pleases.
v.s: Effecter of what He intends.
v.c: Doer of whatever He wills.

v.s: Has there reached you the story of the soldiers -
v.c: Has the story of the ˹destroyed˺ forces reached you ˹O Prophet˺—

v.s: [Those of] Pharaoh and Thamūd?
v.c: ˹the forces of˺ Pharaoh and Thamûd?

q: (instead of taking heed from these incidents and accepting Imaan,)
v.s: But they who disbelieve are in [persistent] denial,
v.c: Yet the disbelievers ˹still˺ persist in denial.

q: ...whereas Allaah surrounds them from all over.
(He knows whatever they think, say and do and will punish them for their evil.)
v.s: While God encompasses them from behind.
v.c: But Allah encompasses them from all sides.

q: (far from being something that can be rejected,)
v.s: But this is an honoured Qur’ān
v.c: In fact, this is a glorious Quran,

q: (and can therefore not be altered in any way).
v.s: [Inscribed] in a Preserved Slate.
v.c: ˹recorded˺ in a Preserved Tablet.
